title: Push-forward of an integer multiplicity current by a C¹ diffeomorphism that is the identity off a compact set
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple representing T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), K ⊆ U compact, and φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P a C¹ bijection with Dφ(x) injective for every x and φ(x) = x for x ∉ K. Then there is an integer multiplicity S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with S(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(φ^#ω(x)) dH^n(x) for all ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), where φ^#ω(x) = ω(φ(x))∘Dφ(x) is the pulled-back covector (so S = φ_#T), and ∂S = 0 whenever ∂T = 0 (BoundaryVanishes; vacuous for n = 0). (The frozen Lean type is character-identical to that of DAG node root.minimizing_implies_stationary-a1.diffeo_pushforward-a1, not yet comparator-accepted; it is declared here under the fresh name Submission.dimred_cdg_c1_diffeo_pushforward_im.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Bijective φ → (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ φ x)) → (∀ x, x ∉ K → φ x = x) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n, IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (BoundaryVanishes T → BoundaryVanishes S) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (φ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ φ x)) ∂μHE[n]
